Results.ReviewText: Weber spirit 2 is a great grill , but needs to have a cover to prolong life of parts . The stainless will tarnish even though it’s stainless and the flavorizor bars and burners will rust out quick . Also the gauge for propane tank is not a accurate gauge . I would spend 20 dollars to buy a separate gauge . Minus that just keep covered and vacuum the inside if used frequently.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have purchased many grills in the past and honestly none have held up to the elements here in NE Ohio, but after 4 years my Weber Spirit II E310 looks and cooks just as good as it did from day one and I use it at least two to three times a week, even more in the better weather months.  You do have to clean it more often if you cook more fatty and marinated meats to prevent flare ups but that is fine with me because I prefer a clean and efficient grill.  I did have to replace the flavorizer bars this spring because I do grill a lot but after 4 years that is the only repair I've had to make and honestly all of the other grills I purchased never even lasted that long so $50 bucks is minimal compared to purchasing a whole new grill for $400 to $500 bucks so it is well worth it to me.  This unit is a well built product that produces superior results, you won't be disappointed.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
